headline_hook: Shazeer Lands at OpenAI, Midjourney Goes Medical, and Claude Code Ships Artifacts
preview_topics: the Transformer inventor's blockbuster move to OpenAI

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Shazeer's move reveals that the Transformer architecture race is far from over — the co-inventor of attention joining OpenAI signals the next frontier isn't replacing Transformers but radically reimagining them from the inside, and the talent consolidation at frontier labs is accelerating faster than the open-source community can absorb.

model_literacy.relevance: Today's HuggingFace survey shows vanilla LoRA is no longer the automatic best choice for fine-tuning — newer variants like DoRA (weight-decomposed adaptation) and PiSSA (principal singular value adaptation) can outperform LoRA on specific tasks, making PEFT method selection a real engineering decision rather than a default.

items.title: Midjourney's Second Act: A Full-Body Scanner for Consumer Health
items.angle: The bootstrapped image generation lab that scaled without VC funding is now betting its architecture expertise on medical imaging — a pivot that redefines what an 'AI company' can be
items.key_fact: Consumer-grade full-body organ scanner positioned as routine health screening

items.title: Claude Code Gets Artifacts — Preview React and HTML Without Leaving the Terminal
items.angle: The interactive previews that made claude.ai sticky now work in Claude Code, closing the gap between chat and IDE workflows for frontend developers
items.key_fact: Supports React components, HTML pages, and data visualizations inline

items.title: AWS Launches Continuum and Context at New York Summit
items.angle: Two new services plus five tool updates signal AWS is building the full infrastructure layer for enterprise agent deployments
items.key_fact: Continuum (AI security at machine speed) and Context (knowledge graph for agents) plus updates to Kiro, DevOps Agent, and Bedrock AgentCore

items.title: MCP Gets Enterprise-Grade Auth — Admins Can Now Centrally Manage Connector Access
items.angle: The biggest friction point for MCP adoption in enterprise — every user managing their own OAuth flows — is gone, making MCP deployable at organizational scale
items.key_fact: Admins pre-authorize OAuth flows so end users never see an auth prompt

items.title: Claude's Code Execution Tool Gets 90-Second Cell Budgeting
items.angle: No more silent timeouts on complex computations — the updated tool version lets Claude budget long-running cells against the time limit
items.key_fact: code_execution_20260521 version, no beta header required

items.title: Ollama v0.30.10 Brings Command A and North Models to Apple Silicon
items.angle: The MLX engine integration expands which models Mac users can run locally without GPU servers
items.key_fact: Command A and North family models now supported via MLX on Apple Silicon

items.title: The Complete Guide to Steering Claude Code: CLAUDE.md, Skills, Hooks, and Subagents

items.title: Beyond LoRA: HuggingFace Benchmarks the Fine-Tuning Methods You're Not Using

items.key_fact: Newer PEFT variants outperform vanilla LoRA on specific task types and model sizes

items.title: Zero-Touch OAuth: How Enterprise MCP Deployments Kill the Auth Prompt
items.angle: The protocol-level companion piece to Anthropic's managed auth announcement — details the OAuth flow that makes MCP invisible to end users

items.title: DeepMind Publishes a Concrete Roadmap for Securing AI Agents

items.key_fact: AI Control Roadmap for securing internal systems against agentic AI risks

items.title: Noam Shazeer Joins OpenAI — The Transformer's Co-Inventor Switches Sides
items.angle: The co-inventor of the attention mechanism and Character.AI founder joining OpenAI is the most consequential AI talent move this year — his architecture expertise could reshape OpenAI's model roadmap
